specification.title: Academic institution leadership
specification.outcome: Design academic strategy while protecting scholarship and educational standards.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original academic-institution leadership cases integrating faculty/curriculum/research/funding/admissions/donors/endowment/autonomy. Full committee decision artifacts, budgets and opportunity costs, actual academic-standard constraints, transparent admissions governance and donor-condition counterfactual. Avoid repeating C01finiteportfolio or C02genericbudget; demonstrate institutional complementarity/standards/conditional funding with full numerical and disciplinary proofs. No actual legal/bylaw authority invented.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
